52
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, March 9, 2018/Phalguna 18, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Railways' plan for funding upcoming
projects
†*151. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the plan being formulated by
Railways to fund its upcoming projects;
(b) whether any timeline has been fixed
for complete financing of Railways;
(c) whether Railways have been
successful to manage any funds in this
regard, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government proposes to
take help from the World Bank for the
same; and
(e) if so, the manner in which
Government proposes to do so and the
outline thereof?
Construction of ROBs at railway
crossings
†*152. SHRI RAM NATH
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
RAILW AYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government,
in view of several recent train accidents,
has decided to build Road Over Bridges
(ROBs) across railway crossings;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a decision to start
construction of ROBs at (i) Western Gumti
of Karpurigram on Muzaffarpur-
Samastipur rail section, (ii) railway crossing
in Muktapur on Darbhanga-Samastipur rail
section and (iii) southern railway crossing
in Darbhanga has been taken; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Divesting of Government equity by
IFFCO and KRIBHCO
*153. SHRI CHUNIBHAI
KANJIBHAI GOHEL: Will the Minister
of CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

53
equity has not been divested legally by
Indian Farmers Fertilizer Cooperative
Limited (IFFCO) and Krishak Bharati
Cooperative Limited (KRIBHCO);
(b) if so, the details thereof, individual
entity-wise; and
(c) the status of action taken along with
the details of action proposed by
Government in the matter?
Doubling the income of farmers
*154. SHRI V . VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee, set up in
April, 2016,  on doubling farmers' incomes,
has submitted its report to Government;
(b) if so, the salient recommendations
thereof and the action taken by Government
on each recommendation; and
(c) if not, whether a deadline has been
set for the Committee to submit its report?
FIR in Aadhaar details leak case
*155. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR: Will
the Minister of ELECTRONICS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to refer to answer to Starred
Question no. 5 given in the Rajya Sabha on
2 February, 2018 and state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
specific names of journalists and
newspapers have been mentioned twice at
page No. 2 in FIR No. 09/2018 dated 5
January, 2018;
(b) if so, the reasons for not providing
this information in the reply to the above
said question;
(c) the basis on which the Ministry has
stated that FIR has been filed against
unknown persons;
(d) whether Government proposes to
withdraw the FIR against journalists and
newspapers and bring the real culprits for
Aadhaar details leak to justice; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
BharatNet project
*156. SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIVAS: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICA TIONS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has proposed
BharatNet project in the country, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether State Governments have
given their consent for implementation of
the project and requested for Central
funding for the project, if so, the details
thereof; and
(c) whether the Ministry has considered
the request of Government of Telangana in
this regard along with the details thereof?
Compensation to farmers under Crop
Insurance Scheme
†*157. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any amount from the farmers as premium
for crop insurance;
(b) if so, the total amount received under
this head from April, 2014 to January, 2018
along with the details thereof, year-wise;
(c) whether compensation has been paid
to farmers out of this deposited insurance
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

54
amount, if so, the details thereof, year-wise;
and
(d) the head under which remaining
amount is being used along with the details
thereof?
Making Agriculture sector profitable
*158. SHRI P. BHA TTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
need to enhance production of agricultural
produces in order to make the Agriculture
sector profitable in the country;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether Government has set any
targets to e

Total number of questions — 160
Drawbacks in e-NAM scheme
1601. SHRI T. G. VENKATESH:
SHRI DHARMAPURI
SRINIV AS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
e-NAM scheme is suffering from ground
level problems like, storage facilities,
distress sale, transportation, etc.;
(b) if so, whether Government has
evolved any method to overcome these
problems, if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government in this regard?
Special package for farmers
1602. SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
provide some special package apart from
crops insurance, etc. to the farmers of the
country, particularly in Maharashtra, in view
of their continuing suicides;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation of funds for fisheries sector
†1603. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
Y ADAV:
SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of various heads/schemes
under which funds were allocated in last
five years to promote the fisheries and
amount released and due (arrears) against
the said allocation along with the details
thereof, year-wise and head-wise; and
(b) whether it is a fact that consecutively
allocated amount to promote the fisheries
has not been satisfactory for these years
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

377
thereby impacting the development of this
sector for want of desired amount in this
sector, the details thereof?
Compensation to farmers for crop
losses due to hailstorm
†1604. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD:
SHRIMATI CHHAYA
VERMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the loss of agricultural
crops due to untimely hailstorm in the
month of February, State-wise;
(b) the amount provided to farmers by
Central and State Governments for loss to
their crops after hailstorm under the Crop
Insurance Scheme to bear the loss resulting
from this untimely hailstorm; and
(c) how old is the rule to assess the
compensation for loss due to various
natural calamities, including hailstorm and
whether the insurance companies and
Government get away from paying
compensation to the farmer under the guise
of these rules?
Damage to orange crops in
Maharashtra
1605. SHRI ANIL DESAI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the unseasonal rain and
hailstorm in February, 2018 have damaged
Rabi crops and led to orange fruits dropping
on a massive scale across Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details of losses suffered
by farmers in 11 districts of the State;
(c) whether village level information has
been provided to the insurance companies
for faster claims;
(d) whether Orange Growers
Association of India has requested the
Centre for releasing some assistance from
the disaster relief funds; and
(e) if so, the response of the Ministry
to the pleas of farmers and fruit growers of
Maharashtra?
Farming of remunerative crops in
place of traditional crops
1606. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state the
assistance given by Government to such
farmers who shift from growing of their
traditional crops to other crops to get more
benefits of their produce?
Use of harmful pesticides in the
country
1607. SHRI PARTAP SINGH
BAJWA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken note
that banned pesticides are used for
production and artificial ripening of fruits,
vegetables and other crops, which have an
adverse impact on human health, soil and
livestock;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any study to identify the level of pesticide
residues in the fruits, vegetables and other
crops;
(d) if so, the outcome thereof; and
(e) the steps proposed to be taken by
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

378
Government to ban the use of harmful
pesticides in the country?

Maharashtra

AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government has
received any request from Government of
Uttar Pradesh regarding situation of
drought in some districts of the State since
2015 to till date;
(b) whether the Ministry has sent any
team to ass
